title: Lightweight is an understatement
text: Lightweight is an understatement. This quilt is super lightweight and from the feel does not seem like it will offer much warmth at all. Seems more like a thicker sheet than a quilt to me.... I ordered the fairest grey/ sky blue, this quilt does not have a stitch of grey on it. It is cream and sky blue (pictures show against two different shades of grey). Also a little disappointed that a week ago I ordered my quilt with shams and they have already reduced the price.
